# SoundTouch 2.3.3 (vendored)

Time-stretch library used for the decks' key lock (tempo change without pitch
change). Library sources only (no BPM detector, no command-line tools), copied
unmodified from the 2.3.3 release:
https://codeberg.org/soundtouch/soundtouch/archive/2.3.3.tar.gz
